answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 145784 Country: Pakistan Title: Can I offer first 4 sunnah of Jumuah after Jumuah? Question: Can I offer first 4 sunnah of Jumuah after Jumuah? Answer ID: 145784 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 160/152/M=2/1438) The 4 rakah sunnah of Jumuah should be offered before the khutbah of Jumuah. You should reach the mosque at a time that you may offer the sunnah of Jumuah. In case you cannot offer it before the Jumuah salah you may offer it after Jumuah salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
